# `event_delivery`

Area: **events** ([all tables](README.md))

One event to one subscription: pending until the worker delivers it or gives up.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Server-generated identifier. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Database insertion time. |
| `event_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The event to send. |
| `subscription_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The hub whose callback receives it. |
| `state` | `event_delivery_state` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no | `'pending'::event_delivery_state` | pending, delivered, failed or dropped (event_delivery_state). |
| `attempts` | `integer` | no | `0` | POSTs tried so far. |
| `next_attempt_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When the worker tries next; set exactly while pending. |
| `last_attempt_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When the last POST was tried. |
| `last_error` | `text` | yes |  | Why the last POST did not succeed (status or error), if it did not. |
| `finished_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When it stopped being pending; NULL exactly while pending. |
